name: Polemos Industries
long_description:
Precision strike is rationed. Forces see more targets than they can afford to hit.

Polemos builds AI-guided ballistic missiles and the compact launchers that fire them, designed for mass manufacturing. Our launchers form a strike network wired into the recon drones already in the sky: a drone geolocates a target, the nearest launcher fires, and a guided round lands in seconds.

Short range, no wasted kilometers, no modified trucks. Built on production lines that already exist, so output scales when it matters most.
one_liner: AI-guided ballistic missiles, built for mass manufacturing

launches.tagline: Mass strike capability, delivered by networked launchers and AI guidance.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: Precision strike, rebuilt for the age of autonomy.**

Polemos Industries (YC F26) is building next-generation autonomous precision strike. Watch the launch [video](https://youtu.be/Tid8NZQvhrE) below and learn more at [polemosindustries.com](http://polemosindustries.com)

**About Polemos**\
Modern war is changing faster than the weapons built for it. The conflicts of the next decade will be decided by speed, autonomy and scale, and the precision strike the West relies on today was built for a different era.

Polemos combines AI guidance, networked launch systems, and mass strike capability into one integrated system. We design our full systems in-house, from guidance to final integration, and we’re building out propellant production so we can scale on our own terms. Everything is built from day one to be mass-manufactured and to protect the West in the next generation of modern warfare.

**The Polemos Team**\
Hey, I’m Henrijs, founder of Polemos. I attended Astra Nova (formerly Ad Astra), the school founded by Elon Musk, where I was part of the first international cohort and focused on aerospace and mechanical engineering. I went on to work hands-on with the engineering teams at two defense companies building autonomous systems fielded by NATO forces, across navigation, firmware, electrical and aerospace production.

I’m building Polemos alongside a team with backgrounds across NASA JPL, Caltech’s GALCIT aerospace lab, the US Army’s DEVCOM Army Research Laboratory and Imperial College London. Their work spans frontline and counter-UAS systems, eVTOL flight testing, space programs and hardware taken from design to production with industry partners across the US and UK.

**The Polemos Manifesto**

Precision and scale, never traded: For decades, the West has had to choose between weapons that are precise and weapons that exist in numbers. Polemos refuses that choice. We build precision strike designed to be mass-produced.

Propellant is power: No munition flies without it, and supply is one of the West’s deepest bottlenecks. We are building our own propellant production so our output is never capped by someone else’s.

Built for the surge: We design every system for mass manufacturing from the first day, so production can scale with the industrial base when it matters most.

Strength in the network: No single system wins alone. We build everything to connect, coordinate and act as one, because the advantage belongs to whoever links their capabilities fastest.

Every round guides itself: AI guidance carries each round from launch to target and takes over in the terminal phase, where precision is decided. Intelligence goes into the munition itself, not just the systems around it.

Precision at scale is how the West stays ahead. Polemos is building it.
